BombVault 7.1.0wfb is a fork release building on 7.1.0.

## Changed

- **GHCR-only publish.** Docker Hub push and README sync removed; images are published exclusively to GHCR.
- **i18n parity.** Added `github.hint` / `github.pathHint` keys to all locale files; fixed golangci-lint and React warnings.

## Removed

- Docker Hub login, metadata, and description sync steps removed from the CI workflow.
